Excellent restaurant
Aug 2026 • Family
Very friendly waiters who offer splendid service. We have been very well taken care of and they have always responded to us when we have needed help or advice. We are traveling with someone who has an allergy and she has been very well taken care of, with special attention paid to whether she could eat the dish or not. The food is very good and it has air conditioning. 
It is also allowed to pay with euros, which has made it much easier for us. 100% recommended.
